module: LuaSocket mbox mailbox parser: splits an mbox file into messages, separates headers and body, interprets the headers and the sender address. E-mail utility with no direct link to the game.
usage:
local mbox = require('libs/luasocket/socket/mbox')
local messages = mbox.parse(contenuMbox)
print(messages[1].headers.subject, messages[1].body)
notes: Bug: split_mbox assigns the global 'mbox' (variable without local), which creates/overwrites _G.mbox on each call; moreover, if 'module' exists, the module is also published in the global mbox.
The header names from parse_headers are lowercased; repeated headers are joined with ', '.

split_message.desc: Splits a message into headers and body (first empty line). Converts CRLF to LF.

returns.desc: Raw headers (empty string if there are none).

split_headers.desc: Splits a header block into lines, unfolding continuation lines.

parse_headers.desc: Parses a header block into a table name (lowercase) -> value.

parse_from.desc: Extracts name and address from a 'From' field of the form 'Name <address>' (or a plain address).

returns.desc: Name (the address if empty, quotes removed).

split_mbox.desc: Splits an mbox file into raw messages, separated by 'From ...' lines preceded by an empty line.

parse.desc: Parses a whole mbox file: list of messages {headers, body}.

parse_message.desc: Parses a message: returns {headers = table of parsed headers, body = body}.
